cards.metric: Conference lead to demo request rate
cards.what_it_measures: Reviewed event contacts converting to demo intent
cards.why_now: Shows whether conferences create real scientific intent rather than just contact volume.
cards.reporting_setup: Custom report using conference_lead_status grouped by conference_name and filtered where owner_reviewed equals Yes.

cards.metric: Time to first meaningful follow up
cards.what_it_measures: Speed from event capture to real prospect-facing follow up
cards.why_now: Conference interest can decay quickly, and slow follow up weakens event return.
cards.reporting_setup: Calculated time between contact create date and last_meaningful_follow_up_date. Draft creation alone does not count.

cards.what_it_measures: Open deals or reviewed conference contacts with a future follow-up task
cards.why_now: Prevents silent stalls during a 6 to 18 month sales cycle.
cards.reporting_setup: Report open deals or reviewed conference contacts where no open future task exists, using hs_task_status and hs_timestamp.

cards.what_it_measures: Whether demos progress into serious technical interest
cards.why_now: A demo is not enough for instrument sales. The key signal is whether the buyer starts evaluating scientific fit.
cards.reporting_setup: Deal stage conversion report from Demo Completed to Scientific Evaluation.

cards.what_it_measures: How long open deals sit without movement or a next action
cards.why_now: A long sales cycle can hide stale deals if next actions are not enforced.
cards.reporting_setup: Deal stage ageing report with filters for open deals, overdue tasks and missing next action.

dashboard_rows.filter: lead_source equals Conference and open or overdue follow-up task exists
blocked draft reason exists, primary_use_case is Unknown, or buyer_role is Unknown
dashboard_rows.purpose: Add context or close out before drafting
